description: This file contains unit tests for functions related to resolving line group keys, configurations, and policies in a messaging application, specifically for LINE groups. It verifies the correctness of ID expansion, configuration matching, and account-specific settings.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupLookupIds
methods.description: Expands a raw ID or prefixed ID into an array of related lookup IDs, adding common prefixes.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupConfigEntry
methods.description: Retrieves configuration entries for a group or room ID, matching raw, prefixed, or wildcard entries.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupHistoryKey
methods.description: Determines the LINE peer key for history tracking based on group or room ID.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupsConfig
methods.description: Resolves the effective configuration for LINE groups, including account-specific overlays.

methods.name: resolveExactLineGroupConfigKey
methods.description: Resolves the specific configuration key for a given account and group ID.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupRequireMention
methods.description: Determines if a group requires mention based on configuration and account scope.
